outputs: The paper evaluates LLMs on IndoMMLU, a multiple-choice question-answering dataset, which involves generating answers to exam questions, falling under natural language generation.

changes_made.explanation: Changed answer from Yes to No. The paper evaluates multiple-choice question answering (an NLU task), not NLG. While NLG datasets/tasks are mentioned in related work, they are not evaluated in this paper. The IndoMMLU evaluation involves selecting from predefined options, not generating free-form text.
Kept 'Accuracy' as the main metric. Removed implementation details (exact match, log likelihood, token probability) as these are technical approaches to computing accuracy, not distinct metrics.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper.

overall_notes: This paper is primarily about evaluating LLMs on multiple-choice question answering (IndoMMLU dataset), which is an NLU task, not NLG. The extracted metadata incorrectly classified it as NLG. The paper mentions NLG benchmarks (GEM, IndoNLG) in related work but does not evaluate any NLG tasks. The evaluation uses accuracy metrics for multiple-choice selection.
